what_happened: All seven $0 gates passed and the dry run stopped before provider creation -- the first invocation in this programme where --dry-run did what it says. Nothing was created and nothing billed.
_a_dry_run_consumes_the_attempt_id: It writes a manifest, and open_run refuses to reopen a recorded run because that manifest describes an execution a second one would overwrite. So the workflow is: dry-run on attempt N, launch on N+1. That is the machinery's contract, established here rather than assumed.
